experiment: Probe-predicted CAS prefix full eta-to-epsilon loop
implication: The full eta-to-epsilon loop works in this likelihood assay: Pythia's own Stage 7 readout can be realized as readable CAS context, and that context moves semantic likelihood in the intended direction. This supports CAS Harness conditioning, not hidden-neuron steering. Raw CAS-symbol prefixes remain ineffective.
plain_english_read: This is the full harness bridge: Pythia hidden states are read by the Stage 7 Foundation probe, the predicted Foundation label is realized into readable CAS context, and Pythia's conditional likelihood is measured.
